text: Usha Rama College of Engineering Approved by AICTE and affiliated to JNTU-Kakinada URCE - Empowering Children to Reach Their Potential. Usha Rama College of Engineering and Technology, established by Usha Rama Educational Academy, with the aim of inculcating quality education to students and produce young technocrats having good knowledge. The college is approved by AICTE and affiliated to JNTU-Kakinada. It is sponsored by Chicago based Multi Million Dollar Advansoft group
